newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BROKERS UNWORRIED BY HANDELSBANKEN MOVE.
newsitem.headline: BROKERS UNWORRIED BY HANDELSBANKEN MOVE.

text.p: Share traders in Estonia said on Monday they were not worried by news that Sweden's largest bank, Handelsbanken, has bought an Estonian broker and intends to start operations in the Baltic state.

Handelsbanken, which became the largest Swedish bank recently after merging with Stadshypothek, earlier said it has bought 100 percent of small Estonian broker Aktoris to become the first foreign bank to enter the Estonian investment market.
"The competition will be a little tougher as they will provide services here," said one broker from a leading Estonian bank.
"There is quite large interest and it will bring additional funds to the local market," he added.
Another dealer said the news was inevitable.
"Obviously we would like to have the market to ourselves, but foreigners are expected to come."
